targetList.finding: Core physiology constants and DTOs are still built around 16 tissue compartments, a 128-byte DecompressionStateDTO, per-tissue rows, and uint status flags.
targetList.requiredAction: Replace 16-row tissue authority with 3 explicit float lanes and introduce StatusEffectStateDTO with ulong StatusEffectMask at offset 0. Remove hot authority dependence on TissueCompartmentDTO[entityCapacity*16].

targetList.finding: IntegrateBloodGasTensionsJob still evaluates a 16-compartment path and mutates uint status flags.
evidence: line 58: ResolveActiveCompartmentCount scales from 4 to TissueCompartmentCount
line 750: loop increments tissueIndex across TissueCompartmentCount
line 836: scalar.StatusFlags is cleared and ORed with gas status bits
targetList.requiredAction: Create EvaluatePhysiologyStateJob over exactly Fast, Medium, Slow lanes. Replace status flag updates with branch-minimized ulong mask set/clear operations.

targetList.finding: Runtime is registered as IUpdatable plus ILateFrameTickable and uses a 0.016 second authoritative interval instead of the existing 10 Hz SlowTick lane.
targetList.requiredAction: Move scheduling gate to ISlowTickable on PriorityLayer.Player or retain a cold injected accumulator driven by dispatcher SlowTick. Keep ILateFrameTickable only for no-wait completion and publish after completion.

targetList.finding: Vault allocation and initialization routes still allocate/read decompression state, tissue rows, and Haldane coefficient rows sized by TissueCompartmentCount.
evidence: lines 793-795: opens DecompressionStates, TissueCompartments, and HaldaneCoefficients
line 2023: initializes tissues with TissueCompartmentCount stride
targetList.requiredAction: Collapse Vault descriptors to DecompressionStateDTO[entityCapacity] and StatusEffectStateDTO[entityCapacity]. Remove coefficient buffer from hot truth route or reduce to a 3-lane tuning DTO.

targetList.finding: Editor diagnostic accessors expose the current decompression DTO and Haldane coefficient route.
targetList.requiredAction: Replace coefficient accessor with 3-lane profile diagnostics or clearly editor-only compatibility output generated from the new compact state.

targetList.finding: Respawn reset path writes 16 decompression tensions and clears uint StatusFlags/ActiveTraumaMask.
targetList.requiredAction: Reset exactly 3 tissue lanes and clear StatusEffectMask with 0UL. Respawn reconciliation must not keep old tissue buffer pointers.

targetList.finding: Metabolism already runs through ISlowTickable and Vault-backed DTOs. It is a usable cadence pattern for physiology integration.
targetList.requiredAction: Use metabolism runtime as registration/cadence precedent. Do not merge metabolism state into decompression truth; bridge through Vault/status mask outputs.

targetList.finding: Hypoxia and narcosis presentation has separate flags and sensory state. It must consume the new ulong mask or an immutable snapshot, not duplicate authority.
evidence: line 63: sets ShinobuPhysiologyFlags.Narcosis on gas flags
line 64: sets Hypoxia when oxygen pressure is low
lines 128-130: sensory flags duplicate hypoxia/narcosis presentation state
targetList.requiredAction: Keep sensory impairment as presentation/visual drift. Feed it from the unified StatusEffectMask and gas scalar snapshot after physiology POST_SIMULATION.

targetList.finding: Required cadence lanes already exist: SlowTick is 0.1 seconds and ColdTick is 1.0 seconds.
targetList.requiredAction: Register physiology solver on SlowTick for 10 Hz truth updates and reserve ColdTick for mock generation, hygiene, or report snapshots.

targetList.finding: Health presentation currently reads uint gas status masks. This is a downstream compatibility target for ulong status migration.
targetList.requiredAction: Expose compatibility low 32 bits during migration or update PhysiologyStateSignal to carry ulong StatusEffectMask.

targetList.finding: Gameplay status mask constants are uint. They are a naming/compatibility source for new ulong bits.
targetList.requiredAction: Introduce ulong StatusEffectBits without destroying public meaning. Keep old constants only as adapter values until call sites migrate.

decompressionStateDto.name: DecompressionStateDTO
decompressionStateDto.arm64Alignment: Offsets are multiples of 8 for the three tissue floats and the 64-bit hash/identity fields. Struct size is one cache line.
decompressionStateDto.notes: Fast, Medium, and Slow tissue values begin at offsets 8, 16, and 24. Limit floats are co-located for branch-minimized threshold checks.

statusEffectStateDto.name: StatusEffectStateDTO
statusEffectStateDto.arm64Alignment: StatusEffectMask is at offset 0. Duration and severity lanes are float pairs aligned on 8-byte boundaries where possible.
transitionRules: toggle is forbidden for gameplay truth because repeated job execution can re-enable resolved effects
duration resolution writes severity to zero and clears the bit in the same job output row

currentRoute: Tick accumulates frame delta and schedules IntegrateBloodGasTensionsJob when accumulated time reaches 0.016 seconds.
LateFrameTick finalizes completed jobs without forced completion.
Some hot outputs already use SignalBus parallel writers, but survival/gas publish still uses GlobalSignals in runtime publish methods.
requiredBridge: Cold boot: open Vault handles for DecompressionStateDTO[entityCapacity], StatusEffectStateDTO[entityCapacity], gas/metabolism snapshots, telemetry ring, and cursor.
SlowTick: if no active physiology job is scheduled, schedule EvaluatePhysiologyStateJob and EvaluateStatusEffectsJob with deltaSeconds = 0.1. Do not poll GlobalRegistry or scene state.

LateFrameTick or POST_SIMULATION: finalize only completed jobs, advance telemetry cursor, publish PhysiologyStateSignal/CombatDamageSignal through typed SignalBus, and export immutable latest snapshots.
ColdTick: execute stress/mock generation, stale-row hygiene, or report snapshots only. No gameplay authority should wait for ColdTick.
VisualSync/UI: consume immutable snapshot and smooth warnings locally. Presentation smoothing must not mutate status truth.

signalDecision.allowedColdPath: HectonEventBus or GlobalSignals only for legacy/cold bridge until downstream code migrates
signalDecision.forbidden: GlobalRegistry hot polling, managed EventBus fanout, per-effect managed timer classes, dictionaries, or same-frame forced JobHandle.Complete
